purpose: Diagnose the five P2E16B fixed-step Reference-invalid cases without executing RossFast and without modifying or retroactively upgrading the P2E16B primary result.

diagnostic_A_direct_duration_ladder.construction: Each solve starts from the same original P2E16B initial state and exact boundary forcing.
diagnostic_A_direct_duration_ladder.endpoint: status, integrated-mass availability/residual, native-rate availability/residual, candidate-state validity, nonlinear iterations, Jacobian builds, linear solves and backtracking attempts
diagnostic_A_direct_duration_ladder.interpretation: Used only to classify direct-step convergence/non-monotonicity. No duration is promoted into the P2E16B primary comparator.

diagnostic_B_same_horizon_refinement.construction: Sequential Reference solves, each next substep starting from the preceding converged candidate state.
diagnostic_B_same_horizon_refinement.endpoint: whether the full 0.0016-day horizon can be completed; final state/storage and total integrated mass residual where complete
diagnostic_B_same_horizon_refinement.interpretation: A refined successful trajectory may explain the P2E16B Reference limitation and inform future REF-HIGH construction, but does not replace the failed fixed 0.0016-day primary Reference request.

next_permitted_action: Implement and execute only the frozen five-case Reference-only diagnostic ladder. Do not execute RossFast in this workunit.
